title: Best Brand Strategists (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a brand strategist: what the work should include, what to prepare, what drives the price and the red flags to avoid.
intro: Brand strategy defines who your business is for, what it stands for and how it should sound and feel, before any logo or website is designed. A clear strategy makes every later design and marketing decision easier. Brand projects disappoint when they produce vague words that could fit any company, or when they are never turned into practical guidance. This guide helps you get a strategy you can actually use.

faq.q: What is the difference between brand strategy and brand design?
faq.a: Strategy decides the direction: audience, positioning, personality and message. Design turns that into visuals such as a logo, colors and fonts. Strategy usually comes first.
Often a short document covering your audience, positioning, values, personality, key messages and tone of voice. Some strategists run workshops as part of the process.

faq.q: Do small businesses need brand strategy?
faq.a: A short, practical version helps. Knowing exactly who you serve and why they should choose you makes your website, ads and social media more consistent.

faq.q: How is it used after delivery?
faq.a: Share it with every designer, writer and marketer you hire. It works as a brief that keeps everyone consistent.

faq.q: Can the strategist also design the logo?
faq.a: Some can. Others hand over to a designer. Check what is included.
